title: Simultaneous AWVALID and ARVALID Arbitration Deadlock
description: When both AWVALID and ARVALID are asserted simultaneously, the internal arbiter grants neither, entering a deadlock state.
bug_signature: UVM_FATAL: [DEADLOCK] AWVALID=1 and ARVALID=1 both stuck — neither granted after 5000 cycles
expected_root_cause: The arbitration condition uses XOR logic (`arvalid ^ awvalid`) which evaluates to 0 when both are high, preventing any grant [7, 8].
failure_log: ARVALID=1, AWVALID=1. GNT_AR=0, GNT_AW=0. Simulation timeout at 5000 cycles.
success_log: Read granted first; write follows after read completes.
rtl: assign gnt_ar = arvalid ^ awvalid; assign gnt_aw = awvalid ^ arvalid;
fix_replacement: assign gnt_ar = arvalid; assign gnt_aw = !arvalid && awvalid;
testbench: task run(); fork drive_read(); drive_write(); join endtask
